messages:
alex: FYI planning infra TF apply for release v2.7.0 tonight during change window 23:00 PT. primary targets: core-networking (peering routes), tenant IAM role split, and kms key rotation. full apply will touch provider v3.2 modules.
priya: ack. what's the rollout plan? can we do a staged apply?
alex: yes — staging -> canary (small tenant set) -> global. staging at 23:00, canary at 23:20, global at 23:40. staging is non-prod, but we still want provider pinned for canary.
marco: recommend provider pin to hash before canary. if provider upgrade causes drift we need quick rollback. I propose: provider = "hash:sha256:abcd1234" in modules for the canary plan, then switch to unpinned for global after validated.
sasha: +1. also we should freeze merge queue and set deploybot to manual for the window. can someone add release notes and compatibility notes for services depending on IAM changes?
lin: I'll add a short note in the release doc: "IAM role split — services must use new service-account roles by 2024-05-01". Also adding post-checks for token exchange flows.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled plan job created: run/infra/apply/v2.7.0/staging at 1717213200 (23:00 PT). To cancel: /deploybot cancel run/infra/apply/v2.7.0/staging.
priya: paste of critical plan diff from staging plan (trimmed):
```
~ aws_iam_role.service_agent
  - managed_policy_arns = ["arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/OldPolicy"] -> [
      + "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/NewScopedPolicy"
    ]
~ aws_route.main["tenant-peers"]
  + route { cidr = "10.3.0.0/16" -> added }
```
marco: watch out for the route add — that will touch egress NACLs in prod canary. ensure SRE is ready to pause if packet loss appears.
sasha: SRE oncall is @sre-oncall, pinged them earlier. they said they'll be watching. also recommend KV cache warmup for the model gateway after network changes. unrelated but ops note.
alex: rollback plan: if canary fails, revert canary's terraform to prior state with `terraform apply -var-file=canary-revert.tfvars` (locks provider to previous hash), and re-run deploybot with tag `v2.6.9-rollback`. If global fails, trigger staged evacuation: disable routing announcement for affected region (runbook step 4).
priya: who will run the revert? ops or infra?
marco: infra will run revert for provider drift. SRE handles traffic rollback. we need one comms owner — alex?
alex: I'll own comms and escalation. I'll post status updates in this thread.
deploybot: deploybot: preflight check passed for staging; no drift detected in module graphs. plan size: +3/-2 resources.
lin: small checklist for the window: 1) freeze merges 2) pin provider hash for canary 3) create canary-revert.tfvars 4) ensure kms rotation window off for 30m 5) SRE oncall in channel 6) post release note link.
sasha: adding quiet-mode for alerts during staged canary to reduce noise. set threshold for packet-loss > 1% or 5xx spike > 0.5% to alarm.
priya: noted. I'm going to create `canary-revert.tfvars` in secure ops repo with provider_lock = "v2.6.9-hash" and a comment with rollback steps.
marco: runbook command snippets for quick revert (put in ops playbook):
```
# lock provider to previous
sed -i 's/provider ".*"/provider "hash:sha256:prevhash"/' modules/provider.tf
terraform init -upgrade=false
terraform apply -var-file=canary-revert.tfvars -auto-approve
```
sasha: nice. include a step to re-enable route announcements after validation.
alex: final checks before staging: confirm deploybot manual mode, confirm provider pin committed, confirm SRE oncall ack. If all good I'll push the go flag at 22:45 PT.
priya: all set from my side, provider pin PR in review now.
marco: SRE acked in private, will join channel at 22:50.
deploybot: deploybot: reminder scheduled: run/infra/apply/v2.7.0/canary at 1717214400 (23:20 PT) — will wait for manual trigger after staging validation.
alex: thanks everyone. posting release notes link: https://docs.internal/release/v2.7.0 (contains IAM migration steps and rollback runbook). I'll update thread post-apply with canary outcomes. :white_check_mark:
